notes: 7-inch PoE-powered wall/tabletop touch panel; no local AC power input exists — device is powered entirely via PoE/PoE+ over its single RJ-45 LAN port (100BASE-TX, so eth-100m grade, not gigabit). No external audio jacks (built-in mic and speakers only, not exposed as ports). A rack mount kit accessory exists (3RU) but the unit itself is a wall/desktop touch panel, not an inherently rack-mounted product, so rackUnits omitted. Variant models (TSW-770-GV government version, TSW-770R ruggedized) may differ slightly; specs here are for the base TSW-770 SKU per Crestron's official specifications page.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 8-pin RJ-45, PoE+ PD (powered device) port; sole power source for the unit
